IS 19068 : 2025 Continuous Hot-Dip Galvanized Steel Bars for Concrete Reinforcement - Specification
ICS 77.140.99; 91.080.40
ICS 77.140.99; 91.080.40
CED 54
CED 54
1 SCOPE
1.1 This standard covers the requirements for continuous hot-dip galvanized steel bars for use in reinforced concrete structures. This specification covers steel bars, with protective zinc or zinc-alloy coatings applied by the continuous hot-dip process.
1.2 This Standard does not cover the requirements for hot-dip galvanized steel bars, and the same are covered in IS 12594.
2 REFERENCES
The standards listed in Annex A contain provisions, which through reference in this text constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of these standards.
